dashboard.label: Operation COLDFIRE: Antarctic Research Expedition
dashboard.description: Real-time operational picture for the COLDFIRE 2025 Antarctic research expedition. Integrates NASA GIBS satellite imagery, station telemetry, and traverse route tracking across the EPSG:3031 polar projection.

search.query: | makeresults | eval mission_start=strptime("2025-01-15", "%Y-%m-%d"), now=now(), days=round((now - mission_start) / 86400, 0) | table days
| makeresults count=1 | eval stations=7 | table stations
| makeresults count=1 | eval personnel=47 | table personnel
| makeresults count=1 | eval km=1842 | table km
| makeresults count=1 | eval samples=312 | table samples
